linuxAgentShot.about: Median and p90 ms of `baneyspaces agent shot` (CLI run included) on a still 1878x1038 foot window in a nested Hyprland, release build: platforms/linux/tests/shot-speed.sh, which fails when the median is over medianMs times regressionLimit, when the still window does not settle, or when a window that keeps drawing does. CI has no Hyprland, so it runs on an Omarchy seat. before* is origin/main 49059ac (PNG captures 120 ms apart) on the same box and window.
